The '''2021–22 Super League Greece''', known as '''Super League 1 Interwetten''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 86th season of the [[Super League Greece]], the top Greek professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1959. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] were the defending champions.

Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season, the play-off winner and one team promoted from [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]]. The first club to be promoted was [[Ionikos F.C.|Ionikos]], after beating [[Ergotelis F.C.|Ergotelis]] 2–1 on 19 May 2021. [[Ionikos F.C.|Ionikos]] played in the Super League for the first time since the [[2006–07 Super League Greece|2006–07]] season. [[Athlitiki Enosi Larissa F.C.|AEL]] were relegated to [[2021–22 Super League Greece 2]], ending their four-year stay in the top flight.
